test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

They are rivals and cannot __work together in harmony__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Pull Together.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PULL TOGETHER means to work together; to cooperate. 

 
 
• **EXAMPLE -** If it's too bright in here, I can pull together those curtains.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **POTTER ABOUT** means to move from place to place doing things aimlessly. 

 
 
• ** EXAMPLE -** I didn't have any plans later, so I spent most of the time ***pottering about******.***
 
 
 
• **MAKE UP** means to become friendly after an argument or dispute.* *
 
 
• * ***EXAMPLE -** I'm really happy that they both ***made up ***after all those misunderstandings.
 
 
 
• **PUT DOWN** means to do something or to say something to criticize someone. 
 
 
• ​**EXAMPLE - **The boss is always ***puttin****g me down* in front of everyone. I feel miserable.
